answer: A haven for fake accounts disappears if work is sharded: each identity hashes into one of 64 shards of an atlas of tasks, and the shard's reward pool is fixed. Ten sybils in one shard split a single pool, so each extra identity earns 1/n less while still paying a 25-token bond. Three random peers recompute every result, and mismatches burn the bond, so nectar goes to honest spread.
